Summary: Validate and Integrate with Existing S3 Export Bucket
Description: Validate configuration and integrate Lambda write permissions with the existing S3 export bucket. Confirm encryption, versioning, and access controls align with pipeline requirements.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given the S3 export bucket already exists
When the Terraform configuration references it
Then bucket encryption using SSE-KMS (CMK) must be confirmed
And versioning must be enabled
And bucket policy must deny non-TLS access
And Lambda’s role must have scoped write access to the export prefix only

Summary: Create Customer-Managed KMS Key (CMK) for Export Encryption
Description: Provision and configure a CMK with explicit key policy for Lambda and S3, including audit logging and rotation settings.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given Terraform defines a CMK and alias
When the CMK is deployed
Then Lambda and S3 principals are granted only kms:Encrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey*
And CMK rotation and CloudTrail logging are enabled
And Lambda must not have kms:Decrypt permissions

Summary: Define Least-Privilege IAM Roles and Policies
Description: Implement IAM roles and policies for Lambda, S3, and EventBridge that follow least-privilege and account isolation principles.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given IAM roles and policies are deployed
When Terraform applies configuration
Then roles must contain only explicit permissions required for Lambda, S3, KMS, and RDS
And no wildcards or PassRole actions are present
And Lambda trust policy specifies only lambda.amazonaws.com

Summary: Implement RDS IAM Authentication and Read-Only DB Role
Description: Enable IAM database authentication on RDS and configure a scoped, read-only role used exclusively by Lambda.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given RDS IAM authentication is enabled
When Lambda uses an IAM DB token
Then RDS must authenticate and authorize the DB user via IAM
And the DB role must have only SELECT permissions
And all connections must use TLS with the RDS CA bundle

Summary: Develop and Deploy Lambda Data Extraction Function
Description: Create a Python 3.11 Lambda that connects securely to RDS using IAM Auth, extracts data to CSV, and writes to S3 with SSE-KMS encryption.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given Lambda executes within private VPC subnets
When the function runs
Then it connects to RDS using IAM tokens
And outputs CSV files to S3 with CMK encryption
And emits structured logs and metrics (RowsExported, CsvSizeBytes, QueryDurationMs)
And handles all errors by category (Auth, SQL, Write)

Description: Create an EventBridge rule that invokes the Lambda daily with retry and DLQ support.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given the EventBridge rule is deployed
When the schedule executes daily
Then Lambda must trigger successfully
And failures must route to DLQ
And Lambda resource policy allows invoke from the rule ARN

Description: Enable CloudWatch logging, metrics, and alarms for the Lambda and related pipeline resources.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given Lambda emits metrics and logs
When execution completes
Then structured logs must be available and retained ≥ 400 days
And alarms trigger on failures or missed runs
And dashboards summarize daily pipeline performance

Summary: Integrate Terraform Validation in CI/CD Pipeline
Description: Implement Terraform plan/apply validation in the CI/CD pipeline to enforce naming, tagging, and security standards.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given Terraform plan runs in CI/CD
When validation is executed
Then resources must pass naming and security rules
And compliance report is exported as a build artifact
And failing plans block deployment

Summary: Validate IAM, KMS, and S3 Security Controls
Description: Perform targeted security tests to confirm IAM and KMS policies and S3 restrictions function as intended.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given the environment is deployed
When unauthorized S3 or KMS actions are attempted
Then they must fail with AccessDenied
And non-TLS requests must be blocked
And access events must appear in CloudTrail

Description: Run a complete EventBridge → Lambda → RDS → S3 flow to validate export functionality, encryption, and metrics.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given the daily schedule triggers Lambda
When the extraction completes
Then a CSV exists under the correct S3 prefix and date partition
And metadata shows CMK encryption
And CloudWatch logs confirm success
And record count and schema match expected query output

Summary: Perform Post-Deployment Audit and Compliance Validation
Description: Verify compliance and traceability through CloudTrail, AWS Config, and IAM Access Analyzer after deployment.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given the system is deployed
When audit tools are run
Then no unauthorized cross-account access is detected
And KMS and S3 access events are logged and traceable
And Config rules report all resources as compliant

Description: Develop CloudWatch dashboards and runbooks documenting metrics, alert responses, and support procedures.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given system metrics and logs exist
When dashboards and runbooks are reviewed
Then dashboards must display key metrics (invocations, errors, latency)
And runbooks describe response actions for common failure scenarios
And operations team approves before production release
